statistics_method: Exact Fraction interpolation of sorted integer ns at p*(n-1), inclusive Q1/median/Q3; ratios of engine medians. IQR overlap is descriptive, not a significance test.

comparison_families.application: Rewritten application on current Relar and CPython; preserved old application on baseline Relar. Changes combine source and compiler/runtime effects.
comparison_families.common-source: Exact old application on current Relar, preserved Relar, and CPython. Current-versus-preserved Relar holds application source fixed.

cross_family_caveat: Families are sequential measurement batches; direct cross-family source-effect ratios are not paired or causal estimates.
provenance_note: Measurements use the clean source commit above. Report and publication files were produced afterward and are not claimed to belong to the measured source tree.
